paras: ANSI/AAMI ST108 is the first comprehensive U.S. standard focused specifically on the quality of water used for processing medical devices. It establishes requirements for water quality management programs, including testing, monitoring, documentation, review, and corrective actions.
The standard recognizes water quality itself as an important patient safety variable in medical device processing.

data.intro: ST108 sorts the water used in device processing into three categories. Find the ones your facility uses to know which test kit to order.

Water treated to remove microorganisms, endotoxin, and minerals
The final rinse of devices, and other steps where water touches the device last
Water turned to steam for sterilization, tested as condensate

data.intro: ST108 puts greater focus on the role water quality plays in medical device processing. Three primary areas of impact include:

items.title: Patients
items.body: Water quality management can help reduce risks associated with microbial or endotoxin contamination.

items.title: Devices
items.body: Proper water quality can help reduce corrosion, pitting and scaling that affect equipment performance and longevity.

items.title: Facilities
items.body: Better water quality management can improve water system effectiveness while reducing maintenance associated with scaling and buildup.

data.sub: Designed for the Facilities That Need a Simpler Solution
data.body: Agenics Affirm™ is particularly well suited for smaller healthcare environments that need to monitor sterile processing water quality without the complexity of a large-scale water management service.

items.title: Ambulatory Surgery Centers
items.body: Including orthopedic, ophthalmology, gastroenterology, ENT and multispecialty surgery centers.

items.title: Office-Based Surgical Practices
items.body: Including oral surgery, OMS, periodontics, plastic surgery and dermatology practices.

items.title: Community-Based Healthcare
items.body: Including FQHCs, community health centers and rural health clinics.

data.h2: A Simpler Alternative to Traditional Water Quality Testing
paras: Facilities commonly rely on water treatment providers, environmental laboratories, or internal monitoring. Each approach can present limitations, particularly for smaller outpatient environments.
Agenics Affirm™ offers another option: an easy mail-in testing solution specifically designed around ST108 water quality requirements.
data.statement: No contracts. No complicated service model. All needed testing materials included.

data.h2: Understand Your Water. Document Your Results.
paras: ST108 calls for water quality management programs that include testing, monitoring, documentation, review and corrective actions.
Agenics Affirm™ provides a simple option for testing and reporting, with results delivered online in a user-friendly format.

Results are ready within 5 business days of the lab receiving your sample, and every measurement is marked in range or out of range against the ST108 standard. That gives the facility the information it needs to incorporate testing results into its broader ST108 water quality management program.
